label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_01
text: Feast your eyes on the majesty of the Polar Plaza\nbattle court![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_02
text: Nah, it’s basically the exact same battle court as\nin the other plazas, just colder.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_03
text: I’m a cold-weather kinda guy. Not what you’d\nexpect from a Dragon-type user, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_04
text: Anyhow, buddy, you came to do my Elite Trial,\nnot listen to me ramble. So let’s hop to it![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_05
text: I call my Elite Trial [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terarium-Only Battles[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_06
text: Your goal’s to clobber three of your fellow\nLeague Clubbers in battle. Simple enough, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_07
text: But it’s called Terarium-Only for a reason! You\ncan only use Pokémon that meet two conditions.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_10
text: First, they gotta be Pokémon that were [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]caught[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]living wild in the Terarium[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_12
text: Second, [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]YOU gotta be the one who caught ’em[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_13
text: Unless your whole party of Pokémon meets\nthose conditions, no Elite Trial for you.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_14
text: I know, I’m asking a lot. But what fun would it\nbe if you just dipped into your vault of beefy\r\nPokémon and cheesed your way through?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_15
text: Your opponents are under the same conditions,\nso you can’t be too mad about it.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_16
text: Whaddya say, bud? Ready for my Elite Trial?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_select_01
text: I’m ready!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_select_02
text: Explain again?

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_select_03
text: Maybe later

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_17
text: That’s your cue, underlings! C’mon out![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_all_01
text: I’m ready!\nHello!			         	  Let’s go![VAR 0x0114(004D)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_18
text: My trial’s about skill, but it’s chill. Take it at\nwhatever pace you want.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_19
text: If you wanna dive right into battling your three\nclubmates, go nuts![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_20
text: Rather stroll around the Terarium catching\nPokémon first? No problem![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_21
text: So go on, get out there and chill it up.\nGood luck! Everyone give it your best shot![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_npc
text: Wanna dive right into battling? Rather go take a\nbreather? Either way’s good.\c\nShow me your skill, but it’s chill.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_a_01
text: I love Pokémon with some brittle gray tones!\nReady to battle me?

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_a_04
text:
Gray-cious me! Your Pokémon do[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0002)]esn’t meet the
trial conditions!\c
Come back with only Pokémon you caught
yourself here in the Terarium!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_a_02
text: Hoo-gray! Good luck to both of us!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_a_03
text: You’ve got my support! I know you’ll do gray-t!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_b_01
text: I’m quite the cool customer. Ready to shiver?

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_b_04
text:
Oh, wait. Your Pokémon do[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0002)]esn’t meet the
conditions for this trial.\c
Come back with only Pokémon you caught
yourself here in the Terarium.

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_b_02
text: Heh. You’re on!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_b_03
text: Don’t let the cold wear you down. I’m sending\ncool waves of encouragement your way.

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_c_01
text: Y’know Iono? The streamer? I use the same type\nas her, so like, ready for a shock?

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_c_04
text:
You know your Pokémon do[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0002)]esn’t meet the trial
conditions, right?\c
Come back with only Pokémon you caught
yourself here in the Terarium!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_c_02
text: Here we go! Zap! Pew pew pew!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_c_03
text: Keep it up! I’ll be watchin’ over your electrifying\nbattles!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_22
text: So that makes, let’s see...\nOne...two...three...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_23
text: Nice! You went and beat all three of ’em![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_24
text: Which means this Elite Trial is Elite Complete![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_25
text: All right, my League Club assistants. Retreat! On\nthe double![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_enemy_all_02
text: Good-bye!\nGood battle!		         	    See ya![VAR 0x0114(004D)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_dragonbb_26
text: Aren’t they great? No grumbling or nothing.\nBuncha sweethearts.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_02_clerk_npc
text: Good luck with the Elite Trial!
